CustomField.description: Determines which giving totals count toward this donor tier. Hard Credits Only: only the donor's own gifts (TotalGiftsAmount / GiftsThisYearAmount + FQS legacy hard credits). Hard + Soft Credits: also includes soft-credit totals (TotalSoftCreditsAmount / CurrentYearSoftCreditsAmount + FQS legacy soft credits). Setting is per-tier — a Major tier can count soft credits while an Entry tier stays hard-only. Defaults to Hard Credits Only when blank. Changing this value recalculates the affected FQS_*_Donor_Level__c / FQS_Is_*_Donor__c formulas retroactively across all Donor Gift Summary records — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose whether this donor tier counts hard credits only, or hard + soft credits combined. Configured per tier — a Major tier can count soft credits (spouses, foundation-driven gifts) while an Entry tier stays hard-only.
CustomField.label: Credit Type
